Credential reset for svc_backup_admin performed via IAM/PAM.
Firewall rule added to block source IP 10.0.5.14 (inbound direction).
Full endpoint scans initiated on DC 10.0.8.200 and four lateral hosts.
Remediation playbooks executed to eradicate footholds and rollback services if needed.
Incident declared contained; monitoring continued for 24 h.
